title: Court fee and the date the lis began

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Kerala doubled its additional court fee in twenty sixteen. Does it hit a tax appeal whose dispute began before that?
scenes.shown: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Kerala doubled its additional court fee in 2016. Does it hit a tax appeal whose dispute began before that?

scenes.dialogue: On twenty sixth October, twenty twenty six, a single bench of Honourable Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas of the Kerala High Court ruled.
scenes.shown: On 26 October 2026, a single bench of Honourable Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas of the Kerala High Court ruled.

scenes.dialogue: This court fee, under Section Seventy Six, feeds the Legal Benefit Fund. A notification raised it to one percent, in force from first April, twenty sixteen.
scenes.shown: This court fee, under Section 76, feeds the Legal Benefit Fund. A notification raised it to 1%, in force from 1 April 2016.

scenes.dialogue: Twelve tax assessees, among them Sobha and Manappuram Jewellers, filed appeals and revisions after the notification, and were told to pay the new rate.
Their plea: the hike impairs a vested right of appeal, and cannot reach older assessment years. The State said every appeal filed after the notification pays.
The Court held: the right of appeal, with its court fee, vests when the lis begins. That is Hoosein Kasam Dada, approved by a Constitution Bench, which still binds.
Nothing in the notification makes it retrospective. So the one percent fee applies only where the lis began after first April, twenty sixteen.
scenes.shown: Nothing in the notification makes it retrospective. So the 1% fee applies only where the lis began after 1 April 2016.

scenes.dialogue: A tax lis begins when the officer, not satisfied with the return, calls for evidence. Sobha's notice came in twenty fifteen, so it need not pay the enhanced fee.
scenes.shown: A tax lis begins when the officer, not satisfied with the return, calls for evidence. Sobha's notice came in 2015, so it need not pay the enhanced fee.

scenes.dialogue: Manappuram's books were called for only in twenty eighteen, so it pays the new rate. In five petitions with no dates pleaded, the appellate forum must find them.
scenes.shown: Manappuram's books were called for only in 2018, so it pays the new rate. In five petitions with no dates pleaded, the appellate forum must find them.
